title: Weird driving rules (Modal verbs) – B1 English Listening Test

seo.title: Weird driving rules (Modal verbs) – B1 English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: Get listening practice and learn with this B1 intermediate comprehension test about driving rules. Feedback & transcription are included!

parts:
B1 English Listening Test

Watch a video about strange driving rules around the world, and for questions 1 to 6, choose the correct option.
See the full list of B1 listening tests
Questions

questions.prompt: When is running out of fuel on a German motorway allowed?

choices.html: Only when you can prevent traffic congestion or an accident.

questions.prompt: What must you do before taking your car in Denmark?

choices.html: Check that the children are sitting safely.
Check that your children are using their seats.
Check that there are no kids near your car.
You can’t wear sandals unless coming from the beach.
You must always wear safe footwear.
You can wear comfortable shoes or no shoes at all.

questions.prompt: What does the video imply about the law in Alaska?

choices.html: You cannot carry a pet unless it’s tied.
You can’t let your dog climb onto the roof of your car.
You mustn’t carry your pet on the roof of your car.
It depends on the number on your number plate.
If you can drive on Monday, you cannot drive on Tuesday.
It depends on the colour of your number plate.

questions.prompt: In Thailand, you mustn’t drive without a shirt…

choices.html: unless your air conditioning is not working.
